tw93-waza-check.description: Reviews diffs, PRs, release readiness, and publishing follow-through. Use when asked to review, triage issues or PRs, or ship. Not for debugging root causes or prose.

tw93-waza-health.description: Audits agent config, instruction drift, hooks or MCP, and AI maintainability. Use when Claude, Codex, or Pi setup looks wrong. Not for application bugs or PR review.

tw93-waza-hunt.description: Finds root cause before any fix. Use when something errors, crashes, regresses, or used to work. Not for code review or new features.

tw93-waza-learn.description: Runs a six-phase research workflow from source bundle to publish-ready output. Use when researching an unfamiliar domain or compiling materials into one reference. Not for quick lookups or single-file reads.

tw93-waza-read.description: Fetches URLs and PDFs, then summarizes or returns clean Markdown; can also search the web through DeepSeek when built-in search is thin. Use when asked to read, fetch, quote, cite, convert, or save a URL or PDF. Not for local text files already in the repo.

tw93-waza-think.description: Turns rough ideas into approved, decision-complete plans before coding. Use when planning architecture, judging whether to build, or writing a handoff. Not for bug fixes or small edits.

tw93-waza-ui.description: Produces distinctive production UI and screenshot-grounded visual polish. Use when building or restyling pages, components, or typography. Not for backend logic or data pipelines.

tw93-waza-write.description: Rewrites and polishes Chinese or English prose, technical instructions, and product copy. Use when drafting, editing, localizing, or cutting AI tone. Not for code comments or commit messages.
